description: Speckle-Reducing Anisotropic Diffusion (Rodinia SRAD v2). Faithful port: the original srad_cuda_1 / srad_cuda_2 kernels with shared-memory neighborhood tiling (BLOCK_SIZE 16). Each SRAD iteration runs both kernels; q0sqr is recomputed each iteration on the CPU from an ROI image-statistics reduction.

scaling_param.name: image_size
scaling_param.description: Image dimension (NxN pixel grid, multiple of 16)

non_scaling_params.name: num_iterations
non_scaling_params.description: SRAD iterations per timed pass (each runs srad_cuda_1 + srad_cuda_2)

non_scaling_params.name: block_size
non_scaling_params.description: Thread-block dimension (BxB); fixed compile-time BLOCK_SIZE=16 in the original kernels
